brief.claim: Among 150 recorded V1 neurons, the neurons that are tuned to orientation have a mean orientation selectivity index of at least 0.25, where each neuron's index is (r_pref - r_orth) / (r_pref + r_orth), r_pref is its mean rate at its preferred orientation and r_orth its mean rate at the orientation 90 degrees away.

data_keys.meaning: non-negative firing rate in spikes/s of each neuron to each of 8 equally spaced grating orientations (0 to 157.5 degrees), 16 repeats of each
